definitions.explanation: A state of competing with others, especially in business contexts where companies vie for the same market or customers.

examples.japanese: {競合|きょうごう}{他社|たしゃ}の{動|うご}きを{注視|ちゅうし}している。
examples.english: We are closely watching the movements of our competitors.

examples.japanese: この{市場|しじょう}では{多|おお}くの{企業|きぎょう}が{競合|きょうごう}している。
examples.english: Many companies are competing in this market.

examples.japanese: {競合|きょうごう}{製品|せいひん}と{比較|ひかく}して{価格|かかく}を{決|き}める。
examples.english: We set prices by comparing with competing products.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競合|きょうごう}{他社|たしゃ} (competing companies, competitors)
- {競合|きょうごう}{製品|せいひん} (competing products)
- {競合|きょうごう}する (to compete)
- {競合|きょうごう}{関係|かんけい} (competitive relationship)
- {競合|きょうごう}{分析|ぶんせき} (competitive analysis)

RELATED TERMS:
- {競争|きょうそう} (competition - general term)
- ライバル (rival)
- {対抗|たいこう} (opposition, competition)
